'''2007 Georgia State Championship Andrew Kaplan DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Kaplan]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Deck name:''' Beat Squad
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
